denn

because

A2 assistant

Part of speech
conjunction
Word order
verb stays in position 2
Topic
Alltag
View source Edit in the editor Edit on the git server
Contents
  • Examples
  • Notes

Examples

  • Ich komme nicht, denn ich muss arbeiten. I am not coming because I have to work.

Notes

denn and weil both mean because. After denn the verb stays in position 2.

Where it appears

  • Hallo! Was fehlt dir denn? Hello! What's wrong with you? In der Praxis model
  • Was hat er denn? What's wrong with him? Termin beim Kinderarzt model
